channel.title: Biotech: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New biotech filings from Korean small and mid caps.

item.title: Curacle filed a US FDA IND application on 2026-11-20 for a Phase 2b trial of CU06-1004 in diabetic macular edema.
Dong-A ST received MFDS approval on 2026-10-30 for Stillen Q Tab, a once-daily acute and chronic gastritis treatment.
Subsidiary Dong-A ST received Korean MFDS approval on 2026-10-30 for Stillen Q Tab, a once-daily acute/chronic gastritis treatment.
